other_mijikenda: Duruma: same name (Pakia App. VI, given for A. zanzibaricum)

teaser.en: The bush's toilet paper: a shrub whose soft, velvety leaves gave it a very practical Digo name.
teaser.sw: Karatasi ya chooni ya porini: kichaka ambacho majani yake laini kama mahameli yameupa jina la Kidigo lenye manufaa ya moja kwa moja.
teaser.dg: Karatasi ya choo ya weruni: chitsaka ambacho makodzage laini dza nguwo ganachipha dzina ra Chidigo rinaroeleza kaziye.

summary.en: Mbangula mavi is a soft-leaved Abutilon shrub with yellow flowers. Its name, 'faeces cleaner', records that its velvety leaves are used as toilet paper.
summary.sw: Mbangula mavi ni kichaka cha Abutilon chenye majani laini na maua ya manjano. Jina lake, 'kisafisha mavi', linaonyesha kwamba majani yake laini kama mahameli hutumika kama karatasi ya chooni.
summary.dg: *Mbangula mavi* ni chitsaka cha *Abutilon* chenye makodza laini na maruwa ga rangi ya mandano. Dzinare, 'cha kubangula mavi', rinaonyesa kukala makodzage laini nkuhumirwa dza karatasi ya choo.

about.en: Mbangula mavi is a soft-wooded shrub up to about two metres tall. It is covered in fine velvety hairs. The leaves are broad and heart-shaped with toothed edges, and soft as felt to the touch. The yellow to orange-yellow flowers look like small hibiscus flowers. The fruit is a ring of hairy, pointed segments arranged like a small crown or wheel, which split apart when dry.
about.sw: Mbangula mavi ni kichaka chenye mbao laini, chenye urefu wa hadi takriban mita mbili. Kimefunikwa kwa vinywele vyembamba laini kama mahameli. Majani ni mapana, yenye umbo la moyo na meno kingoni, na laini kama kitambaa cha fulana yakiguswa. Maua ya manjano hadi manjano-machungwa yanafanana na maua madogo ya hibiscus. Tunda ni duara la vipande vyenye manyoya na ncha kali, vilivyopangwa kama taji dogo au gurudumu, ambavyo huachana vikikauka.
about.dg: *Mbangula mavi* ni chitsaka chenye nyama za muhi laini, chinachofika ure wa hadi mita mbiri. Chosi chinafwinikwa ni nyere ndide laini. Makodzage ni mapana, ga umbo ra moyo, genye meno kanda-kanda, na uchigaguta ni laini dza nguwo. Maruwage ni ga rangi ya mandano hadi rangi ya chungbwa na mandano, na ganahalana na maruwa madide ga *hibiscus*. Tundare ni vipande vyenye nyere na ntsa, vinavyopangwa mviringo dza tadzi ndide au gurudumo dide, na vinatengana vichiuma.

where.en: It grows in bushland, forest edges, old farms and disturbed ground.
where.sw: Hukua vichakani, pembezoni mwa misitu, kwenye mashamba ya zamani na ardhi iliyovurugwa.
where.dg: Chinamera weruni, kanda-kanda ya matsaka, kpwenye minda ya kare, na phatu phenye tsi iriyobanangwa.

uses.en: As the name says, the soft leaves are used as toilet paper in the bush. Pakia notes that the plants named for a domestic use, like *mbangula mavi*, 'are used as their names indicate'.
uses.sw: Kama jina linavyosema, majani laini hutumika kama karatasi ya chooni porini. Pakia anaeleza kwamba mimea iliyopewa majina kutokana na matumizi ya nyumbani, kama *mbangula mavi*, 'hutumika kama majina yake yanavyoonyesha'.
uses.dg: Dza dzinare rinavyoamba, makodzage laini nkuhumirwa dza karatasi ya choo weruni. Pakia anaandika kukala mimea yenye madzina ga kazi za kaya, dza *mbangula mavi*, 'inahumirwa dza madzina gao ganavyoonyesa'.

culture.en: Pakia gives the name as an example of naming by everyday household use, alongside *msasa* ('sandpaper') and *mtsusa tsalu* ('bead cleaner'). He explains *mbangula mavi* as 'clear human waste': the leaves are used to clean (*bangula*) oneself of waste (*mavi*).
culture.sw: Pakia analitoa jina hili kama mfano wa kuipa mimea majina kutokana na matumizi ya kila siku ya nyumbani, pamoja na *msasa* ('msasa') na *mtsusa tsalu* ('kisafisha shanga'). Anaeleza *mbangula mavi* kama 'kusafisha uchafu wa binadamu': majani hutumika kujisafisha (*bangula*) baada ya kwenda haja (*mavi*).
culture.dg: Pakia analavya dzina hiri dza mfwano wa madzina ga kazi za chila siku za kaya, phamwenga na *msasa* (karatasi ya msasa) na *mtsusa tsalu* ('cha kutsusa tsalu'). Anaeleza *mbangula mavi* dza 'kueza mavi ga mutu': makodza nkuhumirwa kudzieza (*bangula*) mavi (*mavi*).

names.en: Digo: *mbangula mavi*, 'faeces cleaner'. The same name is used for the closely related *Abutilon zanzibaricum*, and it is for that species that Pakia gives the meaning and notes that the name is shared with Duruma. Mgombato gives *mavi* as excrement. No English or Swahili name is recorded.
names.sw: Kidigo: *mbangula mavi*, 'kisafisha mavi'. Jina hilohilo hutumika kwa ndugu yake wa karibu *Abutilon zanzibaricum*, na ni kwa spishi hiyo ambapo Pakia anatoa maana na kueleza kwamba jina linashirikiwa na Kiduruma. Mgombato inatoa *mavi* kama kinyesi. Hakuna jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo: *mbangula mavi*, 'cha kubangula mavi'. Dzina hiri hiri nkuhumirwa piya kpwa nduguye wa phephi, *Abutilon zanzibaricum*, na ni kpwa aina iyo ndipho Pakia analavya manage na anaandika kukala dzina hiri piya ni ra Chiduruma. Mgombato inaandika *mavi* dza neno ra Chidigo, sawa na Chiswahili *mavi*. Dzina ra Chingereza au ra Chiswahili tarimanyikana.
